title: ACE-LTT reproducibility package: Fail-Closed Certification of Multi-Stage AI Policies
description: Frozen code, preregistrations, registration and audit receipts, run records and archived detector and verifier outputs for the manuscript "Fail-Closed Certification of Multi-Stage AI Policies" (ACE-LTT, Admissible Cascade Envelope via Learn-then-Test). Rows of the sealed test set, ground-truth labels, images and model weights are not included; see README.md. Every file is listed with its SHA-256 in SHA256SUMS. Code: Apache-2.0; all other files: CC BY 4.0.
